bases.name: Highwind
bases.blurb: Heavily shortened story on one Disc 1 image. Many dialogue choices and scenes are cut. The ending movie plays but is shortened to fit the single-disc layout.

bases.name: CSR+
bases.blurb: CutScenes Removed plus extra scene trims, whole game on one Disc 1 image. Trims cover Hojo, Aerith house, City of the Ancients, and the endgame. Ask-menu removed, Supernova granted. The ending movie plays but is shortened to fit the single-disc layout; other non-ending movies are not preserved.

explainer.base: Base experience — only one applies (Unmodified, CSR, CSR+, Highwind).
explainer.mods: Optional mods from other catalogs appear under Mods when available.
